stem: In a certain factory the number of items per day found to be defective has had the distribution $\text{Po}(1.03)$. After the introduction of new quality controls, the management wished to test at the 10% significance level whether the mean number of defective items had decreased. They noted the total number of defective items produced in 5 randomly chosen days. It is assumed that defective items occur randomly and that a Poisson model is still appropriate.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Given that the total number of defective items produced during the 5 days was 2, carry out the test.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Using another random sample of 5 days the same test is carried out again, with the same significance level. Find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a Type I error in this context.
